subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: What input contract should outbound WhatsApp sticker support promise?
rationale: The transport is already available, but only maintainers can choose whether OpenClaw supports sticker-ready WebP alone or owns static and animated image conversion, metadata, limits, captions, and error semantics.

options.title: Sticker-ready WebP only
options.body: Add typed sticker intent, validate caller-supplied WhatsApp-compatible WebP, and send it without promising conversion.

options.title: Convert static images
options.body: Accept common static images and own resizing, WebP encoding, sticker metadata, limits, and validation.

options.title: Convert static and animated
options.body: Also own animated WebP generation and its distinct chunk, metadata, and size requirements.

recommendation.title: Sticker-ready WebP only
recommendation.body: Add typed sticker intent, validate caller-supplied WhatsApp-compatible WebP, and send it without promising conversion.

likelyOwner.reason: Marcus introduced the existing structured sticker transport and has the strongest recent history across WhatsApp QA and outbound delivery.
